This issue form captures launch-friction feedback only. It is not analytics telemetry.

## Privacy note

Do not include repository contents, filesystem paths, prompt text, token/secrets, branch names, private links, or personal identifiers.
Issue text is optional and not used as analytics.

## What were you trying to do?

Choose one: add the required PR check, generate evidence, verify evidence, or configure the local MCP.

## What was your launch stage?

- [ ] Setup intent: I was trying to start setup
- [ ] Setup progression: I was following setup instructions
- [ ] First pass: I reached or checked a first-pass outcome
- [ ] Evidence result interpretation
- [ ] Feedback or friction only

## Where did you get stuck?

Include the command or setup step. Remove repository names, filesystem paths, tokens, secrets, and private source text.

## What assumption did not hold?

If this task used an incorrect assumption, list it briefly.

## What did you expect?

Describe the next result or explanation that would have made the workflow clear.

## Friction capture (optional)

- Time-to-install estimate (minutes):
- Time-to-first-pass estimate (minutes):
- Assumption risk: how easy was it to correct if wrong?

- GitPin version:
- Operating system:
- Node version:
